listing.name: Omega Start
listing.summary: Three mods that add Derelict custom start, Remnant custom start, Omega custom start & Threat custom start and put the player under their commission
listing.aiSummary: Adds a custom start where the player is commissioned under a hostile Omega faction.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98a] [WIP] Derelict Start, Remnant Start, Omega Start & Threat Start

description:
Three mods that add Derelict custom start, Remnant custom start, Omega custom start & Threat custom start and put the player under their commission
Allow player interaction with Domain Mothership, Remnant Station, Coronal Hypershunt or Threat fleet with Fabricator Unit as semi-working station
Also allow player to pilot automated ships and have fleetwide immunity to solar corona and similar hazards
By default Derelict, Remnant, Omega & Threat are hostile to most factions but there's a LunaLib settings to turn them peaceful to all but Pirates and Pathers
Inspired from the mod Crabshack's Remnant custom start
